p.text: Why did the meeting matter so much to Bobur?
options: Missing it would have cost him his place next year

fb.correct: 'If I had missed this meeting, I would not have a place next year.'

1.say: You look tired. I am. If I had known the road was closed, I would have left at six. Did nobody tell you? It was on the news. If I had listened, I would have heard it. My brother drove that way too. He got here at nine. If he had waited for me, we would have been late together. At least you came. Some people did not. If I had missed this meeting, I would not have a place next year. Is it that serious? It is. If they had chosen somebody else in March, I would be in Samarkand now. And you would hate it. I would. If I had gone, I would be somebody's second choice for years.

grammar.label: third conditional
grammar.form: If + past perfect, would have + past participle
grammar.meaning: an imagined past that did not happen

explanation.en: Both halves point back to a past that is now impossible: 'If I had known, I would have called.' The facts are the opposite: I did not know, so I did not call.
explanation.uz: Ikkala qism ham endi o'zgarmas o'tmishga ishora qiladi: 'If I had known, I would have called.' Haqiqat teskari: bilmaganman, shuning uchun qo'ng'iroq qilmaganman.

grammar.positive_example: If I had left earlier, I would have caught the train.
grammar.negative_example: If I would have left earlier, I would have caught the train.

l1_notes.uz: Shart qismida 'would' ishlatilmaydi — bu ikkinchi shartdagi xatoning takrori.
l1_notes.ru: 'бы' в обеих частях даёт 'If I would have known'.

grammar.label: mixed conditionals
grammar.form: If + past perfect, would + base verb
grammar.meaning: a past condition with a present result

explanation.en: Mix the halves when a past event still affects the present: 'If I had studied medicine, I would be a doctor now.'
explanation.uz: O'tmishdagi voqea hozirgi holatga ta'sir qilsa, qismlar aralashtiriladi: 'If I had studied medicine, I would be a doctor now.'

grammar.positive_example: If they had saved more, they would have a house now.
grammar.negative_example: If they had saved more, they would have had a house now.

l1_notes.uz: Vaqt ikki xil: shart o'tmishda, natija hozirda. Bu farq ko'pincha yo'qoladi.
